subject: planner: move physical opt and cost misc to util and split plan interface (#52224)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to planner changes. Checked the Plan/PhysicalPlan/Task interface split (`pkg/planner/core/plan_base.go`, `pkg/planner/core/task_base.go`), the move of cost flags + optimize tracing to `pkg/planner/util/coreusage`, and the updated plumbing in physical optimization / tracing (`pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`, `pkg/planner/core/plan.go`, `pkg/planner/core/physical_plans.go`) plus cost paths (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver1.go`, `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver2.go`, `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_detail.go`). The changes appear refactor/mechanical; tracing nil-guards are preserved at call sites (only invoking candidate/cost-detail recording when a real tracer exists). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn behavior, privilege/visibility, concurrency, or runtime handling.
